title: Chang Pui Yook buys S$45,700 of BRC Asia Ltd shares
body: Chang Pui Yook bought 10,000 shares of BRC Asia Ltd in a market transaction at S$4.57 per share, for a total of S$45,700. Total interest rises from 1,400 to 11,400 shares, with the stake unchanged.
deemed_interest_text: NA
remarks_text: The shareholding percentages before and after the change are calculated based on the total number of voting issued shares (excluding treasury shares) of 274,350,089 as at the date of this transaction. The notification was made after the prescribed timeframe due to my inadvertent oversight in my capacity as a shareholder and a Director of the Company. I inadvertently failed to notify the Company of my acquisitions of 1,400 shares on 3 December 2025 and 10,000 shares on 12 May 2026. As these acquisitions did not result in my interest crossing the 5% threshold requiring disclosure as a substantial shareholder, the omission was not identified at the time. Upon discovering the oversight during a review of my shareholding records, and noting that the Company's shares were trading at approximately S$4.09 per share, I promptly submitted the requisite Forms 1 to the Company on 24 November 2026. The acquisitions were effected outside the Company's closed trading periods and not while I was in possession of any material undisclosed price-sensitive information in my capacity as a Director.

title: Low See Ching's stake in Hafary Holdings Ltd rises to 98.34% from 25.44% under takeover offer
body: Low See Ching's stake in Hafary Holdings Ltd moved from 25.44% to 98.34% under a takeover offer. The direct interest moved from 109,547,280 to 0 shares and the deemed interest from 0 to 423,388,189 shares. Total interest rises from 109,547,280 shares (25.44%) to 423,388,189 shares (98.34%).
deemed_interest_text: Immediately before the transaction: Low See Ching ("LSC") has a direct interest in 109,547,280 issued and paid-up ordinary shares ("Shares") in the capital of Hafary Holdings Limited (the "Company"). Immediately after the transaction: (1) As stated in the offer document dated 19 October 2026 ("Offer Document") issued by United Overseas Bank Limited ("UOB"), for and on behalf of 23 Capital Pte. Ltd. (the "Offeror"), in relation to the voluntary conditional cash offer (the "Offer") for all the Shares other than Shares held, directly or indirectly, by the Offeror as at the date of the Offer, LSC has provided an irrevocable undertaking in favour of the Offeror pursuant to which LSC has agreed, inter alia, to accept the Offer in respect of all the Shares held by him. On 23 November 2026, all of the Shares held by LSC were transferred to the Offeror. (2) LSC is deemed to have an interest in the Shares held by the Offeror, as he has a controlling interest in the Offeror. As stated in the level of acceptances announcement dated 23 November 2026 issued by UOB, for and on behalf of the Offeror, as at 6.00 p.m. (Singapore time) on 23 November 2026, the total number of (a) Shares owned, controlled or agreed to be acquired by the Offeror and persons acting or deemed to be acting in concert with it and (b) valid acceptances of the Offer, amount to an aggregate of 423,388,189 Shares. The above shareholding percentages before and after the transaction are calculated based on 430,550,000 Shares and rounded to two (2) decimal places.
remarks_text: As stated in the Offer Document, LSC has provided an irrevocable undertaking in favour of the Offeror pursuant to which he has agreed, inter alia: (a) to accept, or procure the acceptance of, the Offer in respect of all his Shares; (b) to waive his rights to receive any cash settlement or payment for his acceptance of the Offer within the time period prescribed under Rule 30 of the Singapore Code on Take-overs and Mergers; and (c) that the total cash consideration payable by the Offeror for such acceptances by him will be regarded as interest- free shareholder loans extended by him to the Offeror.
change_reason: the acceptance of the Offer and transfer of all Shares held to the Offeror

title: Hap Seng Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd ceases to be substantial shareholder of Hafary Holdings Ltd
body: Hap Seng Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd disposed of shares of Hafary Holdings Ltd by accepting a takeover offer. The holders giving notice together disposed of 218,970,000 shares at S$0.6395 per share, for a total of S$140,025,600. Total interest falls from 218,790,000 shares (50.82%) to 0 shares (0.00%). With this, the holder ceases to be a substantial shareholder of Hafary Holdings Ltd.
deemed_interest_text: N/A
remarks_text: On 28 September 2026, United Overseas Bank Limited had, for and on behalf of 23 Capital Pte Ltd [the “Offeror”], announced a voluntary conditional take-over offer, in accordance with Rule 15 of the Singapore Code on Take-Overs and Mergers, for all the issued and paid-up ordinary shares in the capital of Hafary shares (excluding treasury shares) other than Hafary shares held directly or indirectly by the Offeror [the “Offer Shares”] for a cash offer price of Singapore Dollar 0.64 per Hafary share [the “Offer”]. HSIH, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Hap Seng Consolidated Berhad, accepted the Offer on 28 October 2026 in respect of all its 218,790,000 Hafary Shares, representing 50.82% of the shareholding in Hafary. On 12 November 2026, the Offeror announced that the Offer has become unconditional with which HSIH is expected to receive the cash consideration of SGD140,025,600 within seven business days thereof. The disposal was completed on 23 November 2026 with the receipt of full cash consideration. Accordingly, HSIH ceased to be the holding company of Hafary.

title: Gek Poh (Holdings) Sdn Bhd ceases to be substantial shareholder of Hafary Holdings Ltd
body: Gek Poh (Holdings) Sdn Bhd's deemed interest in Hafary Holdings Ltd fell after Hap Seng Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd disposed of shares by accepting a takeover offer. The holders giving notice together disposed of 218,970,000 shares at S$0.6395 per share, for a total of S$140,025,600. No shares are held directly. Total interest falls from 218,790,000 shares (50.82%) to 0 shares (0.00%). With this, the holder ceases to be a substantial shareholder of Hafary Holdings Ltd.
deemed_interest_text: HSCB, which is the holding company of HSIH, is deemed to have an interest in Hafary shares in which the HSIH has an interest. Gek Poh is the holding company of HSCB. Accordingly, Gek Poh has a deemed interest in the Hafary shares in which the HSIH has an interest. Gek Poh ceased to be deemed substantial shareholder of Hafary upon the cessation of HSIH as substantial shareholder of Hafary.
relationship_text: Gek Poh is the holding company of HSCB which is in turn the ultimate holding company of HSIH.
acting_party: Hap Seng Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd
